retrievalProfile.description: A centered vertical portrait framed by a wide solid-color border with distinctive 1970s-style bubble lettering at the top.
triggerTerms: framed vintage portrait with wide margins

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular photograph of a woman in a tie-dye dress standing in water, set against a large, solid olive-tan border. The top margin features large, interlocking bubble-style outline typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical image framed by a thick uniform border
Typography positioned in the top margin, overlapping the frame edge
Warm, earthy color palette in the border contrasting with vibrant dress colors
Soft, natural lighting in the photograph
coreInvariants: Wide solid-color border framing a central rectangular image
Interlocking bubble-style outline typography at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body portrait centered vertically and horizontally within the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant red and blue tie-dye dress serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top typography, move down to the subject's face, and follow the dress to the water's surface.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the wide olive-tan border surrounding the central image.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and browns (water and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central subject against a low-saturation, mid-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Muted earth tones for the frame
Primary colors restricted to the central photograph

letterConstructionRules: Extreme rounded terminals and tight apertures
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are shortened to maintain a compact horizontal block
Letters share common paths where they touch
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone decorative display type; no secondary fonts.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric roundedness of the era
Captures the 70s display weight and curves

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a central rectangular photograph of a woman in a 70s tie-dye dress standing in a river, surrounded by a wide, solid olive-tan border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom interlocking bubble-lettering outlines in the top margin using a thin black stroke and no fill.

verificationChecks: Is the border color a muted olive-tan?
Are the letters interlocking and outlined?
Is the photograph centered with a clear rectangular boundary?
Does the typography feel characteristic of 1970s design?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the photo frame is perfectly centered
Confirm the color palette is muted and earthy
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color border + Centered rectangular photo + Top-aligned interlocking bubble outline text
